plugin.note: Goblins have negligible Defence and a max hit of 1, so any weapon clears them. The common level-2 Goblins near Lumbridge are the fastest to finish the task.

requirements: No combat, Slayer, or quest requirement to be assigned Goblins.
Level 5 and 13 Goblins, Cave goblins and guards, and the Bandos room Sergeants also count.
All counted variants benefit from the Slayer helmet / black mask.
mechanics: The common level-2 Goblin has 5 Hitpoints and max hit 1 (crush).
Goblins have no elemental weakness; melee, ranged and magic are all accurate against their -15 defence bonuses.
Goblins are a fast, trivial starter Slayer-XP task.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill the common level-2 Goblins near Lumbridge or Goblin Village with any melee weapon.
steps: Travel to the Lumbridge-to-Goblin-Village road or Goblin Village.
Kill the level-2 Goblins (5 HP); no food is needed.
The dense Goblin Village pack is fastest for the task streak.
notes: Higher-level Goblin variants also count if you prefer more Slayer XP per kill.

methods.label: Ranged or Magic
methods.summary: Attack the Goblins with a bow or spells to train Ranged or Magic on a trivial target.
requiredOrKeyItems: A shortbow and arrows, or air spells
steps: Bring a shortbow (or an air staff) to a goblin spot.
Attack the Goblins; their negative defence bonuses make every hit land.
notes: Goblins are a classic low-level Ranged and Magic training target.
